about_the_game:
Life Dash is your ticket to a hilarious and exciting cartoon world where you race to build your dream life—faster than your friends! In this playful yet strategic life-sim, every decision matters, from choosing what to eat, where to work, when to study, and how to invest your money. Can you master life's balancing act and reach your dreams faster than anyone else?

Live, Learn, Earn, Repeat!
Each week is a turn, packed with choices: get a job, upgrade your skills, buy food, or maybe risk it all on gold, stocks, or commodities. Every action you take moves the clock forward, bringing new opportunities—and surprises—your way.

Explore a Colorful Cartoon World
Dive into a vibrant world filled with charming characters, fun mini-quests, and delightful surprises that make every turn fresh and exciting.

Choose Your Own Strategy
Play it safe or take risks! Invest wisely, upgrade your career, or focus on happiness—how you play is entirely up to you. Each path offers unique rewards and challenges.

Key Features:

  • Weekly Decision-Making: Make choices on work, study, spending, investing, and more, shaping your character's future week by week.

  • Mini-Quests and Adventures: Embark on entertaining side quests that boost your stats and keep gameplay dynamic.

  • Cartoon-style World: A colorful, inviting world to explore, full of quirky characters and immersive locations.

  • Friendly Competition: Race friends or global players to see who can fulfill their goals in the least amount of time.

  • Learn While You Play: Develop real-world skills, from financial literacy to effective decision-making.

Dive into Life Dash and start turning everyday choices into a thrilling journey to success. Your future awaits—how fast can you get there?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (M1/M2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel Iris Graphics or Apple M-series GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 5000+) or equivalent dedicated GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
